initial page makes no external request, wallet request or automatic refresh
desktop, intermediate and mobile layouts reflow without page overflow
fee table scrolls with keyboard at 320px
skip link and sequential focus reach the primary refresh control
copy address works with keyboard and writes the exact formal token address
clipboard denial leaves a selectable full-address fallback
native disclosure opens with Space and exposes exact atomic values
snapshot download matches displayed saved block and integer amounts
measured rendered text/background pairs meet 4.5:1
automated accessibility scan of expanded production page
forced-colors focus remains visible; reduced motion has no animations to run
text spacing stress does not create page overflow
CSS 200% enlargement reflows without page overflow (not native zoom)
RTL structural mirror remains contained; translations are out of scope
refresh loading, success and floor-rounded separate-asset display with deterministic RPC fixture
download after refresh contains the newly displayed values, not the original saved file
a complete secondary snapshot replaces a partial primary without combining providers
partial failures render unknown without wiping a separately successful asset read
failed refresh preserves last displayed data and explicitly labels it stale
all browser RPC requests use the fixed public read-only allowlist

Deterministic refresh states use labelled RPC fixtures, not live earnings evidence.
